reviews.text: Took my dog for nail trimming. They returned her to me with a bloody paw and my dog shaking. All he said was “accidents happen and he has the licenses required” then put a powder on it. He got upset for pointing out her bloody paw. I have been coming here for years but the quality has really gone down. It’s no longer the same as before. Wouldn’t recommend coming here at all.

My family members and I have gone here and had a great experience at first and today has been such a disappointment crazy upcharge from 80 now it’s sudden 120 plus 20 more for flea treatment that they mentioned at the end I have to pay and he wasn’t even showered yet and been there since 9 am crazy  and unprofessional miscommunication definitely not coming back we trust our babies and not knowing what really goes on I dropped off my baby at 9am and he was supposed to be ready at 11-12 it’s literally 2:20pm

Awful. Charging Beverly Hills prices in South Central. They quote $80 to bathe a large breed dog but charged $150 excluding tip to bathe my shedding husky and he came back with clumps of fur still on his body. They didn’t even get the shed out. The same service cost me almost half the price in Glendale. Sketchy place with sketchy staff and made up prices.
I asked them to let my dog's fur grow longer, and they cut it however they pleased. 😡 …
Dogs always come back cut and uneven but they smell good

Lucky I even paid them,  they didn't deserve a dime. I would never return. If it weren't for my wife, I wouldn't have paid them anything for grooming my toy poodle. The female groomer is pleasant, but the male groomer is disrespectful and lacks accountability for his poor skills. He talks negatively in their grooming room instead of addressing issues directly with me. If your dog has a challenging coat, avoid this place. They ruined my toy poodle's fur, leaving it uneven and patchy. Their excuse was that his hair was tangled, but no other skilled groomer had ever claimed that. If that were true, they wouldn't have also messed up my cousin's American Bulldog and my mom's cat, leaving them with a patchy cut. I don't know what products they use, but the dogs always come out extremely itchy. They give em back to you with hair like they don't clean them after the cut. I would give them 0 stars if I could. 23rd and Central does a much better job.
Excellent service. I've been taking my dog ​​there since he was one year old, and he'll be 12 in August.

I was recommended this place, but I would never go back. I wouldn't have paid them anything to groom my toy poodle, but the groomer is friendly. The groomer is disrespectful and doesn't take responsibility for his lack of professionalism. He talks badly about you behind your back instead of addressing problems directly. If your dog has a difficult coat, avoid this place. They ruined my toy poodle's coat, leaving it patchy and uneven. Their excuse was that his hair was matted, but no other professional groomer has ever said that. I don't know what products they use, but the dogs always leave extremely itchy. I would give them zero stars if I could. They do a much better job at the shop on the corner of 23rd and Central.
Walk in are welcome that what I like about this place
I would never bring my dog here. Terrible please.
Love this place they always do a good job 👍🏽 …

Great service and price... they treated my babies as they would their own pets... I will continue to bring my babies here to this groomer who offers great services and great pricing and I'd definitely recommend their services for your pets
I loved this place. I highly recommend it. They treated my dogs very well.
They are very careful with our senior chihuahuas and they provide good advice and great service.

I love this place! They really care about your pet. Patient and kind to all fur babies! Great job grooming and making sure your pet is clean and healthy.

I love this place! They truly care about our pets. Patient and kind with our furry babies. Excellent job cleaning and making sure your pet is clean and healthy.
